captions.text: AccessFinish connects a keyboard repair to evidence that the task actually finished.
The booking date was mounted on a div. Keyboard users could not type a date.
Nemotron on Nebius authored three source edits after an operator supplied the diagnosis.
The controller normalized line endings, then built 83 JavaScript files and ran the keyboard booking.
The stored appointment matched. A fresh browser reopened the same booking with the same date and customer.
This is a new read-only check of the isolated database and a fresh browser. No new model request or booking.
One guided development case. General autonomous repair and screen-reader usability remain unproven.
